reviews.t: I have found my perfect curling iron
reviews.x: I have been looking for a good curling iron 3 months. I ordered a couple and had to return them despite thousand positive reviews. I have curly healthy hair, but frizzy and hard to curl.  My criteria for my curling iron: 1. SAFE for my hair. (So, ceramic/tourmaline barrel, temp settings). 2. Convenient. (Some curling irons have buttons in the wrong place and I accidentally changed the temp). 3. Within my budget. Now, why I like this Iron. 1. I am not sure about the infrared thing since I used it

I have very thick hair that does NOT like to keep a curl!  With this curling iron, it does!  I've only used it once so far, but I curledon't my hair around 10:00 a.m. and at 9:00 p.m. I still had my curls!!  I also love how fast it heats up!!  A true keeper!!

reviews.t: The Clamp Doesn't Hold My Hair!
reviews.x: I just used this curling iron today for the first time.  I like everything about it EXCEPT...I have fine, stick-straight hair, and as I section it out to clamp/roll it, it falls right out, and so with each curl, no matter how much or how little hair I put in the clamp, I had to re-roll several times because it kept slipping out.  I've been using curling irons for 40 years and have never had this issue.  I really wanted to like this item, but unfortunately I'll be sending it back.

This is a great quality curling iron.  Very smooth, does not pull my hair like other curling irons.  This is a good size to add curl to medium length hair.  There are several different heat settings which is helpful.  It comes with a heat protecting glove which is a nice touch.

I received the product on time and found it both easy to use and effective. It's got a longer barrel than my old curling iron and I love that the clamp has a gap (rather than being solid) so my hair can breathe a little bit. I've used it a few times and my hair doesn't feel overheated or burned, but the curls come out nicely. Great choice!

Bought this for my mom for Christmas and it ended up breaking within a couple months. I tried contacting their customer service e-mail for a replacement but the e-mail address couldn't be found. Tried finding another way of contacting them through their website, but no luck!  Does the job, but I wish it didn't break so fast.
This curling iron is well made and is packaged well.  I like the different temperature settings and that it comes with a heat protection glove.  The curls lasted all day, great product!

I ordered this curling iron because the description indicated it would be "easy on my hair and less damage" with its use of infrared heat. I ordered through Prime, was delivered on time and I love the way it glides through my hair. I have curly hair and most irons are hard to get through it, this one is not. My hair slide through the clamp and gave me a pretty and soft curl.

reviews.t: The Best Curling Iron I've Used
reviews.x: I've used curling irons for 30+ years and I thought that one was as good as the other. Hands down, this is the best curling iron I have ever used! I have very fine hair, so I can set it at a lower setting. It is gentle, still works perfectly and grabs a big section of hair. It is super quick and easy. I'm not sure why it is so different, but it is... I'm a convert!

After looking at several curling irons and reading the reviews, I settled on this Zara one.  I am so happy with the quality and value of this curling iron.  It heats up quickly and gives me soft beautiful curls and beach waves.  It does not frizz or fry my hair.  It is light-weight and easy to use on both the right and left sides.  100% satisfied!

reviews.t: Not as hot as I would have liked.
reviews.x: I haven't had a curling iron in years so this was a difficult purchase for me. I based it on price and reviews. This was fine, but I was disappointed that it didn't get hotter. Maybe it was the use I was using it for - trying to spiral curl kids hair for a stage production. Anyway, I'll still keep it because it will be great for other uses.

Can't say enough about this curling iron!  my last curling iron really damaged and pulled on my hair causing breakage. This curling iron is the smoothest curling iron I have ever used! My hair just glides through it. It has three heat settings and appears to heat very fast. Most importantly, my hair looks and feels healthier!

This is a great curling iron. I bought this before a girls trip with some friends and it was used by a few of us. It was easy to use, and heated up super fast! The curls were the perfect size and I love that the iron is big enough to wrap my long hair around the barrel. Great purchase!
I love this curling iron. It heats quickly.  Love this. Super hot and great curls. It's easy to use and created beautiful, long-lasting beachy curls on my long, straight, doesn't-hold-curl hair.
This is a great curling iron. The curls hold very well in a humid climate. The 1-inch curls are almost too tight for my daily use.  I would love the same iron at the 1.5-inch size!
Gets super hot, works as expected. You DO NOT need to buy a glove, it comes with one.
I had never tried Xara products before but am very pleased with my curling iron!

reviews.t: A Great Find - Curls Stay Intact - UPDATE: Black enamel on barrel wearing off after 4 months of use.
reviews.x: I was using an old Conair curing iron which I thought was a good curing iron but my hair always smelled burned and the curls would always fall out. Apparently I didn't know any better! To keep the curls intact I started curling my hair with a one inch straightener but that was causing major breakage to my hair. I purchased the Xara one inch infrared curling iron and it has been great. It actually curls my hair at the lowest heat setting and my hair does not smell burned! I know all heating tools

However, recently I really wanted the beachy wave look of current styles.  I am not one to spend a ton of time on my hair, but I thought I would give this curling iron a try since it had good reviews. reviews.t: I highly recommend this curling iron
reviews.x: I highly recommend this curling iron.  I love the different heat settings so I don't have to fry my hair to get a nice curl.  Nice long cord too.  The one thing that could be improved is the instructions on its use.  They need to say to hold down the "On/Off" button to go to the different heat settings.  That being said, if you're looking for a good curling iron the Xara is it!

Love this curling iron. I purchased this product after reading many other reviews.  I must say that it lives up to all the positive feedback I came across. It is lightweight.  It has a long, swivel cord which makes it very easy to twirl while curling hair.  I have shoulder length hair and it works perfectly on my bangs, to my longer, thicker hair in the back. Highly recommend it.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how fast the curling iron heats up.
Many reviewers say it glides smoothly through hair without pulling or damaging it.
Reviewers commonly highlight the multiple heat settings and the included heat-protecting glove.
Several reviewers report curls lasting all day, even on hard-to-curl hair.
A few reviewers report problems: the clamp not holding fine hair, the unit breaking within months with unreachable customer service, and it not getting hot enough.
